title: Resume of a Releasable begin-preparation hold skips the same-authority check that boot re-admission applies
outcome: The Releasable branch of release_engram_begin_preparation_hold_for_resume (src/engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs) re-admits a held head and its rebind expires the old issued grant. It should require that the retained evaluate's connection and admission settings match the current binding target, as readmit_engram_begin_preparation_holds_on_boot_locked does. Otherwise it should report a deterministic reason and keep the hold, or the exception should be documented with its consequence. Today, after a project's Engram settings change interrupts such a head, Resume re-admits it under the new authority. If the authority store changed, the rebind cannot expire the old store's issued grant. The outcome equals Cancel plus a resend, so the impact is limited. A test covers a settings change followed by Resume.
acceptance: Resume of a Releasable begin-preparation hold skips the same-authority check that boot re-admission applies is done
